description: This Java class implements a ContentRepository for Amazon S3, providing methods to save, delete, and fetch files and images in an S3 bucket within the Fineract project.

classes.name: S3ContentRepository
classes.description: Implements ContentRepository to handle file storage operations in Amazon S3, including saving, deleting, and fetching files and images.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Saves a file to S3, validating size and generating the storage path.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Deletes a file from S3 given its path.

methods.name: saveImage
methods.description: Saves an image to S3 from an InputStream, validating size.

methods.name: saveImage
methods.description: Saves a Base64 encoded image to S3.

methods.name: deleteImage
methods.description: Deletes an image from S3 given its location.

methods.name: fetchFile
methods.description: Fetches a file from S3 and returns as FileData.

methods.name: fetchImage
methods.description: Fetches an image from S3 and returns as FileData.

methods.name: getStorageType
methods.description: Returns the storage type, which is S3.

methods.name: putObject
methods.description: Uploads an object to S3, handling exceptions.

methods.name: getObject
methods.description: Downloads an object from S3, handling exceptions.
